sci-desc: Maamul ilaha tixraacyada adigoo kaashanaya [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org Semantic MediaWiki]
sci-scite-parser-not-enabled-namespace: #scite laguma isticmaali karo magac-bog aan laga hawlgelin Semantic MediaWiki
sci-scite-parser-no-type: #scite ma awoodin inuu go'aamiyo nooca tixraaca ee "$1".
sci-scite-parser-no-citation-text: #scite ma samayn karin qoraalka tixraaca ee tixraaca "$1" sababtoo ah nooca "$2" looma qoondeyn [[MediaWiki:Sci-template-definition|tusmada]].
sci-datavalue-empty-reference: Tixraaca xigashada lama filayo inuu madhnaado.
sci-datavalue-invalid-id-value: "$1" waa qiime aan ansax ahayn oo loogu talagalay nooca $2.
findcitablemetadata: Hel xogta meta ee la tixraaci karo
action-sci-metadatasearch: Raadinta xogta meta ee Semantic Cite
listcitationreferencebacklinks: Liiska xiriirrada dib u celinta ee tixraacyada xigashada
sci-metadata-search-read-only: Kaydka xogtu wuxuu ku jiraa hab akhris-keliya ah, waxaana laga yaabaa inuu carqaladeeyo abuurista bogagga tooska ah.
sci-metadata-search-has-match: Aqoonsiga waxaa lala waafajiyay ilaha tixraacyada ee ka kooban isla aqoonsiga, waxaana ku jira: $1.
sci-metadata-search-cached: Jawaabta raadinta waxaa laga soo qaaday kaydka.
sci-metadata-search-intro: Fadlan geli aqoonsi oo dooro bixiye adeeg (waxay u baahan tahay xiriir internet oo firfircoon) si xogta meta ee la soo heli karo loogu waafajiyo qaabka #scite.
sci-metadata-search-intro-pubmed: [[Property:PMCID|PMCID]] ee PubMed Central iyo [[Property:PMID|PMID]] ee kaydka PubMed
sci-metadata-search-intro-ol: [[Property:OLID|OLID]] ama lambarka ISBN si loogu waafajiyo diiwaanka OpenLibrary
sci-metadata-search-intro-viaf: Lambarka [[Property:VIAF|VIAF]] si looga raadiyo Faylka Maamulka Caalamiga ah ee Dalwaddii
onoi-remi-request-error: Codsiga REST/HTTP wuxuu ku soo noqday "$1" ee "$2".
onoi-remi-response-empty: Jawaabtu waxay ku soo noqotay natiijo madhan oo loogu talagalay "$1".
sci-tooltip-citation-lookup-failure: Waxaa fashilmay in laga soo helo tixraac ku habboon qaybta dambe ee "$1".
sci-tooltip-citation-lookup-failure-mult: Waxaa fashilmay in la soo helo qoraalka tixraaca ee "$1" oo leh is waafajinno badan.
smw-pa-property-predefined__sci_cite_key: "$1" waa sifo hore loo qeexay oo aqoonsata il tixraac, waxaana bixiya kordhinta [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Semantic_Cite Semantic Cite].
smw-pa-property-predefined__sci_cite_ref: "$1" waa sifo hore loo qeexay oo aqoonsata il tixraac marka loo isticmaalo tixraac ahaan (tusaale, tixraac qoraalka dhexdiisa), waxaana bixiya kordhinta [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Semantic_Cite Semantic Cite].
smw-pa-property-predefined__sci_cite_tex: "$1" waa sifo hore loo qeexay oo ka kooban qoraal horay loo qaabeeyey, waxaana bixiya kordhinta [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Semantic_Cite Semantic Cite].
smw-pa-property-predefined__sci_cite: "$1" waa sifo hore loo qeexay oo ay bixiso kordhinta [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Semantic_Cite Semantic Cite], taas oo qeexaysa dhammaan qaybaha tixraaca laguna kaydiyo sida shay hoosaad.
smw-pa-property-predefined__sci_doi: "$1" waa sifo hore loo qeexay oo ay bixiso kordhinta [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Semantic_Cite Semantic Cite], taas oo matasha Aqoonsiga Shayga Dijitaalka ah.
smw-pa-property-predefined__sci_pmcid: "$1" waa sifo hore loo qeexay oo ay bixiso kordhinta [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Semantic_Cite Semantic Cite], taas oo matasha lambarka tixraaca PubMed Central (PMCID) kuna xira waraaqaha qoraallada oo buuxa ee PubMed Central.
smw-pa-property-predefined__sci_pmid: "$1" waa sifo hore loo qeexay oo ay bixiso kordhinta [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Semantic_Cite Semantic Cite], taas oo matasha Aqoonsiga PubMed ee shay, kana duwan [[Property:PMCID|PMCID]].
smw-pa-property-predefined__sci_oclc: "$1" waa sifo hore loo qeexay oo ay bixiso kordhinta [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Semantic_Cite Semantic Cite], taas oo aqoonsata diiwaannada buug-gacmeedka ee lagu kaydiyo WorldCat (OCLC).
smw-pa-property-predefined__sci_olid: "$1" waa sifo hore loo qeexay oo ay bixiso kordhinta [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Semantic_Cite Semantic Cite], taas oo aqoonsata diiwaannada OpenLibrary.
smw-pa-property-predefined__sci_viaf: "$1" waa sifo hore loo qeexay oo ay bixiso kordhinta [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Semantic_Cite Semantic Cite], taas oo aqoonsata Faylka Maamulka Caalamiga ah ee Dalwaddii.
